brief: A Spanish-language home-care app where a nurse records vitals, doses and handoffs and the family follows along. Named after Oliva, the founder's grandmother, whose care inspired it. It should feel warm, calm and trustworthy, never clinical.
criteria: Success: avoids the category's crosses, hearts and houses; carries Oliva's name and story; reads at 16 px; works in one colour.

concepts.name: La O
concepts.idea: The O of Oliva holds an olive leaf at its heart: the person cared for, at the centre.
rationale: Her initial and her tree in one shape: the name and the story in a single mark
Olive tree: centuries of life, peace, and growth that needs tending
No crosses, hearts or houses; warm olive instead of clinical blue
Disc plus leaf survives 16 px; a small cut widens the leaf for favicons

recommendation: Final: La O with the rounded oliva wordmark, deep olive (#3A5A2C) with a leaf green (#A9BD7A) on warm cream (#F5F2E6).
next_steps: Trademark search (OEPM / EUIPO, app stores, domains)
Rename copy in the app and stores
Optional: draw a custom display font from the wordmark
